solution.title: Endpoint Reporting & Dashboards for Intune and Configuration Manager

products.name: Endpoint Reporting & Dashboards for Intune and Configuration Manager — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable endpoint reporting and dashboard layer across Intune and Configuration Manager — patch, compliance, encryption, app, and health reporting that produces the same trusted numbers every time. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Turn Intune and Configuration Manager data into reports leadership and auditors actually trust

You manage thousands of endpoints, but when someone asks "how many devices are patched?" or "what's our compliance rate?" the honest answer is a scramble through three consoles and a spreadsheet. This solution gives you a repeatable endpoint reporting layer across Intune and Configuration Manager: standard reports for patch status, compliance, encryption, app deployment, and device health, plus dashboards that pull from Intune reporting and Graph — so the same numbers come out the same way every time.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Intune and Configuration Manager reporting data sources, Intune device/compliance reports, Microsoft Graph data export, what good endpoint KPIs look like, and the reusable dashboard model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Configuration Manager reporting, Graph permissions/app registration for exports, a reporting destination, KPI definitions) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: define the KPI set, enable and locate the built-in Intune/Configuration Manager reports, set up Graph-based data export, assemble dashboards, schedule recurring reports and distribution, then validate the numbers and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — reporting-readiness discovery, report-data validation (reconcile counts), a consolidated endpoint KPI report (patch/compliance/encryption/health), a scheduled export helper, and a reporting-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Trustworthy, repeatable endpoint reporting — patch, compliance, encryption, app deployment, and device health across Intune and Configuration Manager — with the same numbers every time for leadership and auditors, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • EPRPT-Discovery.ps1 — reporting-readiness check for endpoint reporting & dashboards
    • EPRPT-Export-Scheduled.ps1 — Microsoft Graph exportJobs helper for Intune report data
    • EPRPT-Report.ps1 — consolidated endpoint KPI report (patch / compliance / encryption / app / health)
    • EPRPT-Set-ReportingScopeTargeting.ps1 — build the reporting-scope Entra security groups
    • EPRPT-Validation.ps1 — reconcile reported KPI counts against the live Intune source counts

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
